artworks.title: Old Woman with Cats
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman in profile, facing left. She is sitting on a stool, with her upper body slightly bent forward, and she appears to be holding something. Her hair is covered by a headscarf that hangs down in loose strands. The woman is dressed in a long garment with ample fabric, suggesting a robe or dress with draping. Nearby, there is a small basket on the ground and a cat resting near her feet. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Two Pilgrims
artworks.description: The image shows two tall figures standing side by side. The person on the right has long hair, a beard, and wears a large hat with a shell decoration. They have a draped cloak with a scallop shell on the shoulder and carry a staff. The person on the left is shorter, with a hood covering their face, also holding a staff. They wear thick, flowing fabric. The background shows small figures in a busy marketplace or village setting.

artworks.title: Captain of the Barons
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.6 × 9.3 cm (1 13/16 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a person in a striding position, facing right. They wear a cap with feathers, have messy hair and a thick beard. The person wears a loose, tattered outfit with large sleeves and pants, holding a bundle over their shoulder with a stick. The background includes a village scene with a church, figures in the background, small houses, a rocky formation, small trees, and few other people.

artworks.title: The Hurdy-Gurdy Player
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.3 × 9.1 cm (5 5/8 × 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing confidently, facing slightly to the right. He has a beard and long hair covered by a large hat. He wears loose-fitting clothing, boots, and a cloak, holding a hurdy-gurdy against his torso. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Beggar with Crutches and Cap
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14 × 9.4 cm (5 1/2 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man supported by two walking sticks, leaning forward. He has a beard, wears a hat with an emblem, and has long unkempt hair. He is dressed in loose, tattered clothing with a cloak on his shoulders and worn footwear. The background is minimal.

artworks.title: Beggar with Crutches and Hat, Back View
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.1 × 9.3 cm (5 9/16 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a person seen from behind, standing in a forward stance while leaning slightly to the left and using two crutches for support. The person wears a wide-brimmed hat covering their facial features, with the head slightly bowed forward. The clothing includes a loose-fitting jacket and tattered pants, as well as wraps or loose footwear on their feet. The background is plain and unadorned, highlighting the figure.

artworks.title: Beggar with Pot
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.3 × 9.1 cm (5 5/8 × 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man standing, slightly hunched over, holding a walking stick in one hand and a bundle of cloth in the other. He has prominent facial features, deep lines on his face, a beard, sparse and unkempt hair, and wears loose-fitting clothing, including a cloak or heavy garment draped over his shoulders, layered garments, and large boots. The man carries a bundle and is situated against a plain background.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman with Rosary
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.5 × 9.4 cm (5 11/16 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing bent forward, leaning on a walking stick. The person's face is partially covered by a bonnet and they are wearing a long gown, head covering, and shoes. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: Two Beggar Women
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14 × 9.3 cm (5 1/2 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-bodied figures standing close together. The person on the left wears a hood, a long robe, and holds a container with a string of beads. The individual on the right wears a long robe and extends their arm towards the container. Both figures wear simple, thick clothing and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Blind Beggar and Companion
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.5 × 9.6 cm (5 11/16 × 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from head to toe. The person on the left is facing right, hunched over with a stick for support. They have a bushy beard, wear a brimmed hat, short-cropped hair, and a long cloak. The person on the right is standing straight, facing forward, with a long, disheveled beard, wearing a head wrap and loose clothing. They hold a hat in one hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Beggar with Crutches and Sack
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.3 × 9.3 cm (5 5/8 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with a slight hunch, using a crutch under each arm for support. He has rugged facial features with a long, unkempt beard and bushy eyebrows. He has thick, disheveled hair and wears a headband or turban. His clothing is loose and tattered, including a long cloak, layered garment, patched pants, and worn shoes. The background is a plain surface.

artworks.title: Beggar with Rosary
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.3 × 9.3 cm (5 5/8 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure of a person standing and slightly hunched over. The individual is holding a hat in one hand and the other arm is hanging by their side. The person has a full beard and their hair appears somewhat unkempt and short. They are wearing a flowing garment, with layered clothing visible underneath. Around the person's neck hangs a long string of large beads with a cross attached at the end. The background is a plain, textured surface that keeps the focus on the individual.

artworks.title: Beggar with Bare Head and Feet
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.3 × 8.9 cm (5 5/8 × 3 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his head tilted down and gazing ahead. He has shaggy unkempt hair and a short uneven beard, wearing a long tattered robe that covers his body. One hand emerges as if holding the robe closed, while his legs are covered with the same fabric and his bare feet are visible. There are no visible accessories or objects held. The background is plain with simple shaded lines near the man's feet suggesting ground or shadow.

artworks.title: The Sick Man
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14 × 9.1 cm (5 1/2 × 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows a man sitting cross-legged, holding his left foot with both hands. He has a thin face, sunken eyes, tousled hair, and an overgrown beard. He is dressed in loose, draped clothing with a cloak that is fastened at the neck. A small jug with two handles is positioned between his legs. The background is plain paper.

artworks.title: Beggar with Wooden Leg
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with crutches. The person has a beard, is wearing a hat with a feather, tattered clothing, and one foot in a sandal. The background is plain.

artworks.title: One-Eyed Woman
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly woman standing upright. She is facing forward with her head slightly tilted and a stern expression. She is dressed in a heavy gown with wide sleeves, a fur-lined muff, and boots. Her hair is covered with a matching hood. She is holding a walking stick for support and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman with Crutches
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with crutches. They appear to be wearing a long robe and a headscarf or bonnet, and have a neutral expression.

artworks.title: Mother and Three Children

Beside them stands another child wearing a wide-brimmed hat, with a round face and a neutral expression. The background is plain.

artworks.description: The image features a drawing of an elderly man standing upright. He is holding a stick with one hand, dressed in a long cloak and pants. He has a beard, furrowed brow, and wears a cap. The background is plain, with no other visible elements.
